SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' 
  AND t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE'
